newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kyotaru rises after news of Katokichi support plan.
newsitem.headline: Kyotaru rises after news of Katokichi support plan.

text.p: Shares of Kyotaru Co Ltd rose more than 30 percent on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on Wednesday morning after media reports that the company plans to receive support from Katokichi Co Ltd.
Kyotaru was up 14 yen, or 33.33 percent, to 56 yen by 0144 GMT.
Kyotaru was the largest percentage gainer on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Turnover was 4.85 million shares.
Katokichi was down 20 yen at 1,950 yen.
Kyotaru, which operates a chain of sushi restaurants, sought protection from creditors under Japan's bankruptcy laws last month in order to restructure its operations.

The Japanese daily Asahi Shimbun said on Wednesday that Kyotaru told the Tokyo District Court on Tuesday that it planned to receive help from Katokichi, which produces frozen food, in order to restructure its business, which could start as early as next month.
